shape=[(0,0),(0,1),(1,2)]
def stamp(g):
    g=g.copy()
    H,W=g.shape
    out=g.copy()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W and g[y,x]==0 for y,x in cells):
                for y,x in cells: out[y,x]=8
    return out
